findings.desc: guard false-negative gap: `gitFile` wrapper (handlers/worktree.ts) is absent from GIT_CALL_OPENERS in main-write-lock-coverage.ts. The guard scans gitCli/runGitNoThrow/runGitArgs/git/execSync/execFileSync but not gitFile. Currently the only gitFile mutation-verb calls are commit-tree + update-ref refs/heads/story/<id> in createScopedStoryBootstrapCommit (story-branch creation, not a main mutation — correctly unguarded). BUT if a future developer adds gitFile(["commit",...], root) to commit to main, the coverage guard would silently give a PASS instead of flagging a VIOLATION. The guard comment at line 177-183 lists 6 recognized wrapper shapes and does not document gitFile as an intentionally unscanned wrapper, making this a latent blind spot. Fix: either add gitFile to GIT_CALL_OPENERS (noting cwd is 2nd arg), or add a doc comment to GIT_CALL_OPENERS listing gitFile as intentionally excluded because it is only used for story-branch plumbing ops (not main mutations).
